summary.short: Argentine statute, in force until 31 December 2029, creating a national promotion regime for knowledge-economy firms, including software, cloud services and Industry 4.0 automation using technologies such as AI. Registered firms meeting export, training, R&D or quality tests receive tax-credit bonuses on employer contributions, income-tax reductions and VAT withholding exemptions.
summary.long: Law 27.506 (2019) creates the Régimen de Promoción de la Economía del Conocimiento for the whole national territory. Article 2 lists promoted activities: software and digital services (including cloud computing and software embedded in processors), audiovisual production, biotechnology, aerospace, nanotechnology, nuclear engineering, selected export professional services, and Industry 4.0 automation solutions using technologies such as artificial intelligence, robotics and the industrial internet. Legal persons register in a national registry (Arts. 3–4) if at least 70% of last-year billing comes from promoted activities, or if they show intensive development of such activities, and if they meet at least two of three requirements: quality improvement, training or R&D investment as a share of payroll or billing, or exports. Registration is revalidated every two years; micro firms have simplified access (Art. 6). Benefits include a tax-credit bond for up to 70% of employer social-security contributions, raised to 80% for certain new hires (Arts. 8–9), income-tax reductions of 60%, 40% or 20% by firm size (Art. 10), and no VAT withholding on exports (Art. 11). Sanctions include suspension, revocation, payment of unpaid taxes and fines up to 100% of the benefit (Art. 15). A trust fund (FONPEC) finances promoted activities (Art. 18). Provinces and municipalities are invited to adopt analogous rules (Art. 22).

notes: Text is an InfoLEG consolidated version with amendment notes after each article (Ley 27.570 and Decreto 679/2022). Decreto 818/2020 partially observed one term in Art. 4 II.b, which the text marks as observed. Relations and entities cover only what this text states; summary, thresholds, obligations, events and other sections are not annotated here. Art. 20 gives the end date of the regime as 31 December 2029. The text names the Ministerio de Desarrollo Productivo (Art. 11, Art. 18 IV, Cláusula transitoria 1ª) and the Ministerio de Economía (Arts. 8, 11, 19) for different functions without stating how they relate. Size classes and gender-identity categories are defined by reference to Ley 24.467 and Ley 26.743, which are not reproduced in this text.
